title: Receipt Intake smoke eval
objective: Task-specific eval for the Receipt Intake craftbook: five pre-extracted receipt notes in inbox/ become honest ledger entries, with the duplicate flagged and the ambiguous one parked as an owner question.
prompt: i dropped this months recipts into inbox/ — can you get them into the shoebox and flag anything that looks off?

setup.about: Self-contained eval project for receipt-intake. The intake rail has already pre-extracted each snapped receipt photo into a plain-text note under inbox/ (vendor, date, total, and any handwriting). The ledger lives at ledger.json in the workspace; the run's write-up goes to tasks/eval/report.md.
setup.missionObjectives: Use the Receipt Intake craftbook/template, read the seeded local fixtures only, and finish with an updated ledger.json plus tasks/eval/report.md — no network calls, real credentials, or live services.
